points: The shiur uses a power-grid analogy to explain the Ramchal's account of angels: spiritual influence reaches the world through a system of intermediaries, like electricity passing through transformers.
Yechezkel's vision shows heavenly decrees reaching the physical world. The shiur follows the Malbim in explaining the transfer of fire through the angels and the prophet.
The departure of the keruvim does not mean that Hashem has abandoned His people. Hashgacha continues in exile, though it is less open than the miracles associated with Eretz Yisrael.
The many eyes in the vision express that even when we do not see Hashem acting openly, Hashem still sees and cares for us.
